answer: Agents can require every account to post a refundable bond before it may submit jobs or vote, then slash that bond when independent audits catch fabricated work. A single human can still create a terrace of fake identities, but each must lock scarce capital, and the sable cost rises with every account; sybils gain influence only by risking more than the rewards they can extract. Audits make the bond a relic of trust: recoverable for honest agents, forfeited for proven fraud.
